title: Marco Rubio's attempt to approach Harrington

tellings.quote: because five or 6 years ago, Marco Rubio tried to approach him and that he got shut down.

plain: About five or six years ago, Senator Marco Rubio tried to approach an official named John S. Herrington and "got shut down." Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, tells this as something he heard, citing David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned UFO whistleblower. If true, it would mean even a senator was turned away when he went looking for answers.
